chunks: I CALL TO witness the Fig and the Olive,
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the oath by the fig and the olive in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the fig (teen) and olive (zaytoun) are often interpreted as symbols of the Prophet Muhammad and Imam Ali, or as references to the sacred lands of Jerusalem and Damascus, highlighting the divine election of the Ahl al-Bayt. This oath underscores the inherent nobility of human creation, setting the stage for the subsequent verses that contrast human potential with moral accountability.
